name: signature-pad
purpose: Captures a handwritten signature with mouse, pen, or touch on a high-DPI canvas with smoothed, pressure- and speed-aware strokes, undo, clear, and PNG or SVG export. A typed-name mode is always available for keyboard and screen-reader users. A Form control: the hidden input carries a PNG or SVG data URL.
whenToUse: Acknowledging documents: offer letters, policies, timesheets, delivery receipts.
Any place a person must sign in the browser, with a typed alternative.
whenNotToUse: Legally qualified electronic signatures (certificates, identity proofing): use a signing service; a drawn image alone proves little.
Free drawing or annotation: the pad has one pen and no shapes.
responsive: The pad fills the container width at a fixed height (default 10rem); strokes are stored relative to the pad, so they rescale when the width changes.
rtl: The toolbar mirrors and the placeholder starts at the right; strokes are geometry and are not mirrored.
theme: Component tokens signature-pad-ink (default pen color, color-text), signature-pad-bg (color-surface), and signature-pad-guide (boundary and baseline, color-border-strong); ink and guide are 3:1 against the pad in the contrast gate. Forced colors draw the pad boundary and default ink in CanvasText.
timezone: Not applicable. Point times are relative milliseconds within a stroke.
security: No HTML is rendered; the typed name is drawn on the canvas and escaped in SVG export. penColor, height, and typedFont are validated before use; positions use the CSSOM (CSP-safe).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. The value (stroke points or the typed name) and exported images stay in the page until the app sends them.

performance.testedScale: Up to 20,000 points per signature (excess points are dropped).

limitations: The default ink color is read when drawing; after a theme change, a resize or update() redraws with the new color.
Exported PNGs have a transparent background.
unsupported: Erasing parts of a stroke (undo removes whole strokes).
antiPatterns: Offering drawing only: the typed mode is the keyboard and screen-reader alternative (WCAG 2.1.1).
Treating the image as proof of identity.
